findings.title: Thermometers are provided and accurate.
findings.comment: Observed that there was not a stem thermometer available at the temporary service station to confirm receiving temperatures. PIC was informed that even for short food services, a food temperature measuring device is necessary to be able to confirm that proper temperatures are being maintained, especially following transit from the original kitchen where the items were cooked. Ensure that the establishment has a stem thermometer available at the next inspected event to confirm temperatures.
findings.citation_text: 4-302.12 Food Temperature Measuring Devices. (A) FOOD TEMPERATURE MEASURING DEVICES shall be provided and readily accessible for use in ensuring attainment and maintenance of FOOD temperatures as specified under Chapter 3. (B) A TEMPERATURE MEASURING DEVICE with a suitable small-diameter probe that is designed to measure the temperature of thin masses shall be provided and readily accessible to accurately measure the temperature in thin FOODS such as MEAT patties and FISH filets. [Pf]

findings.title: Proper cold holding temperatures.
findings.comment: There was a bottle of teriyaki sauce, a bottle of sweet chili sauce, and a bottle of mild barbecue sauce that all stated to “refrigerate after opening”. These sauces were on a shelf in the kitchen and were being stored outside of refrigeration. CORRECTED- This was discussed with the PIC and the sauces were all discarded. Ensure that the labels are read on all sauce bottles and that sauces are refrigerated after opening if the label states to do so.
findings.citation_text: 3-501.16(A)(2) Time/Temperature Control for Safety Food, Hot and Cold Holding. (A) Except during preparation, cooking, or cooling, or when time is used as the public health control as specified under §3-501.19, and except as specified under (B) and in (C) of this section, TIME/TEMPERATURE CONTROL FOR SAFETY FOOD shall be maintained:(2) At 5°C (41°F) or less.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment: Inspector observed the separate staging area dump sink to not be caulked to the wall. PIC had the sink caulked immediately. Ensure that all equipment attached to walls in areas of high moisture are caulked.
findings.citation_text: 6-501.11 Repairing. PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair.
